init_wandb_singleton: initialize a WandBSingletonLogger instance with config, run_id, run_name, log_dir, project, and entity parameters
log_wandb_metrics: log a dictionary of metrics to wandb using the WandBSingletonLogger singleton with an optional step and split prefix
log_wandb_table: log a wandb table with column names and row data using the WandBSingletonLogger singleton instance
watch_model_gradients: watch a PyTorch model parameters and gradients with the WandBLogger or WandBSingletonLogger at a specified log frequency
log_tensor_stats: log tensor statistics to wandb on the master process using the log_stats convenience function with a prefix and tensor
